alt: Harry Kane in a white England shirt, mid-stride on the pitch during England vs Ghana on 23 June 2026, the same player the Ballon d'Or website prematurely named winner of the award alongside two other nominees
story: Hours before the October 26 Ballon d'Or ceremony at London Palladium, the award's official website accidentally published pre-written 'winner' articles for multiple nominees simultaneously — declaring Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappé, and Lamine Yamal each the 2026 winner — because France Football had prepared a full article for every nominee in advance and their CMS published all of them; Kane ultimately won for real.
why_funny: The organization whose entire brand is a year-long dramatic build-up to a secret reveal had their website spoil it — for three different winners at once — because they prepared all the endings but forgot to lock the drafts.
